problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:

* Shipment Alpha: size 31 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 60 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 39 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 62 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 37 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: size 30 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: size 48 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: size 65 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Omega: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment A1: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment B1: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment C1: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment D1: size 31 cubic meters
* Shipment E1: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment F1: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment G1: size 37 cubic meters
* Shipment H1: size 32 cubic meters
* Shipment I1: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment J1: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment K1: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment L1: size 37 cubic meters
* Shipment M1: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment N1: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment O1: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment P1: size 42 cubic meters

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of freight. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes possible. Every shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume loaded onto any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
